title: Marge nursing Zutty at home, with Alma's help
summary: Marge cared for Zutty at home rather than a hospital, keeping him quiet on a salt-free diet; their daughter Alma, a nursing supervisor, took his blood pressure daily.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
